en: Miri: So this is the ruin that\nreproduces memories...

It's a lot simpler than I
imagined. I thought there'd be
rows and rows of machines I've
never even seen before.
Let's keep moving forward. Miri,\nTed, <player>.

Millie: I'm scared of the past
repeating itself. Lati said the
moment Dorne collapsed was
reproduced here...

And when Fidel came back
from here, he looked pale and
kept muttering, "The fish
guts..."
Miri: Aren't you scared, Lymle?\nDon't you have a past you'd\nrather not remember?
Even the painful things are an\nimportant part of who I am.
Huh?
I couldn't... help them...
I'm so... sorry...
Sad memories are precious\ntoo. They all connect to the\nLymle of today.
Miri: Lymle...
You're right...! The past is what\nmade me who I am today!

Yeah! Even the parts of the
past I want to turn away from
are all part of me. Alright, let's
go!
Whoa!
I won't have to listen to your\njokes for a while, then.
You gonna miss 'em?
I'll be relieved.
That's harsh, hahaha!
Make sure you come back in\none piece.

I'll definitely make it back in
time. Until then, I'm counting on
you to look after everyone in
Sthal.
You got it.

This is the memory of when
Fidel left for the Royal Capital
to protect the village from
bandits.
Come to think of it, that's\nwhere their adventure truly\nbegan.
It looks like there's more to the\nstory.
Well then, I'm off.
Yeah.
Ted, you have quite a terrible\nlook on your face.
Meryl... Is the clinic okay?\nThere must be many injured\nfrom yesterday's raid.

Meryl: The worst is over. Now,
all we can do is watch over
their healing abilities and wait
for them to recover slowly.

Meryl: Right now, I felt I wanted
to watch the back of the hero
as he sets off to save this
village.
Meryl: ...He looks just like his\nfather.

Meryl: Are you anxious?
Wondering if we can protect
this village from Eitalon while
Fidel is away.

N-No way! I'm the reason the
village was saved last night! If
anything, I'm worried about
Fidel; he's surprisingly
airheaded!
Meryl: Hehe, I see. I shouldn't\nhave compared you to me, Ted.
Comparing me to you, Meryl?

Meryl: When my childhood
friend Daril left this village, I
had the exact same expression
on my face as you do now.

Watching him head off on a
journey far more dangerous
than mine, I thought only of
myself... I'm truly pathetic...

But once I started worrying if I
could protect everyone if the
village were attacked while he
was gone, I couldn't stop the
thoughts...
Meryl: After all the commotion\nlast night, it is only natural to\nfeel uneasy.

Meryl: Watching Daril leave, I
worried about things that
hadn't even happened, like the
Trecour Navy attacking from
the sea.

Meryl: It was right around the
time rumors of war with the
neighboring country of Trecour
were circulating.

Meryl: If I may offer some
advice as someone who has
been there: "You are not
alone."

Meryl: Let us all protect the
village together while we wait
for Fidel to bring us good
news.
...You're right. Thank you, Meryl!

Noooooooo!!! It's not a painful
past, it's a past so incredibly
embarrassing I want to look
away!!!
What am I saying?! Why am I\nbeing so pathetic?!

Read the room, you ruins!!
There had to be something
else! Like a cool scene for me
or something!!
This is just how Ted is all the\ntime.
You're right, Ted is surprisingly\nprone to worrying.
Eh?

Even when Miki got mad at
your joke the other day, you
looked so depressed, though
Miki didn't really mind that
much.
You were hovering around Miki\ntrying to apologize, and it was\nactually kind of in the way.

Ugh... everyone sees right
through me... I mean, Miki,
please pay a little more
attention to me...!
But I understand how you can\nget lost in your thoughts when\nyou're alone.
Even I, when I was away from\nLati and all by myself...
Ah!
Lucio: Are you an idiot? Writing\nletters that will never even\nreach anyone.
Leave me alone.
Oh, look! It's Auntie Judy's\nhouse! She helped us out back\nin Silvarant in the past!
Silvarant in the past?

Yeah. Lati and I traveled 300
years back through the Time
Gate to save our childhood
friend, Dorne.
300 years ago!? I knew it, you\nguys really are on some\nincredible journeys.
Heheh! Well, I am one of the\nheroes who saved the universe,\nafter all!

That's not what I meant... This
is a memory from when I
traveled to the past and ended
up separated from everyone.
The floor is covered in letters.\nWhat on earth do they say?

To Lati... it's Millie. Since I've
always been by your side, I
never thought I'd be writing
you a letter...

I don't know where to send it,
so this is my only choice. Lati,
are you really here? I've lost
track of how many days it's
been...
Waaaaah! Don't read it!!

What's with the sudden
outburst? Painful pasts and
embarrassing pasts are all part
of the important Millie, right?
No, no! Absolutely not!!

I was suddenly all alone, so I
started overthinking things! I
wrote nothing but super
embarrassing stuff!!

Right after that, I thought
being so mopey wasn't like me,
so I gathered the letters and
just threw them all outside!
And then...
And then?
Lati popped her head out from\nunder the pile of discarded\nletters.
Haha, nice timing, Lati!
It's a happy ending.
That is not a happy ending at\nall!

I was so mad that I yelled "Lati,
you idiot!" and threw the
letters, so now a huge crowd is
gathering...
...and Lati won't give me back\nthe letters I threw!
But the words in those letters\nare Miri-tan's true feelings.

True, those letters were your
honest feelings, Millie, so it's a
good thing Lati got to hear
them.
It is NOT good!! I was all alone\nand it was snowing outside, so\nI just got a little sentimental!
Come on, don't dodge the\nsubject. Just be honest.
Hmph... I really don't want to\nhear that from you, Ted.
Wh-what? Why specifically\nfrom me...?
I think I'll go home and tell Miki\neverything I just saw~♪
W-wait, seriously, stop! Wh-why\nMiki?! I could handle you telling\nFidel, but...!

It's no use trying to hide it~.
You're so easy to read, Ted.
You're the only one who hasn't
realized it.
W-W-What do you mean I'm\neasy to read, Millie!!
Both Ted-tan and Miri-tan need\nto learn how to be more\nhonest.
It's just as <player> knows.\nLymle is always such a good,\nhonest girl!
...Ugh!
Faize, you idiot!
You traitor!
Faize-kun is the biggest idiot of\nthem all!
What are they doing? Insulting\nFaize to a wall?
And even Sarah-san is joining\nin...
Lymle remembers this. It was\nwhen we were heading toward\nKuro-tan's planet.
...Back then, Faize followed\nKuro-tan...

Even so, what's going on? Even
if it's vocal training, the
content is anything but
peaceful.
It was Sarah-tan's idea. She\ntold me we should shout insults\nat Faize together!

Sarah-san did? I can't imagine
the gentle Sarah-san
suggesting something like
that... right, Captain?
Hmph! You're doubting Lymle!
Lymle-chan, you look like you\nhave nothing to do. Why don't\nyou join me in shouting?
Shouting?
Yes! Let's shout together.\nReady... Faize-kun is, um, well,\nan idiot!
...Sarah-tan?
Faize-kun is, um, well, an idiot!\nFaize-kun is, uh, so, let's say it\nagain, an idiot!

See! This all happened before
Lymle shouted that Faize is an
idiot! Lymle's innocence is
proven!
Sarah, why are you suddenly\ndoing this...?
Eleyna-san was saying this\nbefore~.
E-tan was?

They say if someone is being
badmouthed, people will rush
to their side from anywhere, no
matter how far away~.
From anywhere... no matter\nhow far...
That's why you should join me,\nLymle, in shouting bad things\nabout Faize!
If we do that, I'm sure... right?
...It's not like I actually want to\nsee Faize.
Oh, Lymle...
But I am all for badmouthing\nFaize. Sarah, you have to shout\nit with me, loud and clear!
Faize is... an idiot! A big, stupid,\ndummy idiot!
That's the spirit, Lymle! Now,\nlet's shout it from the bottom\nof our hearts!

Oh, so that's what it was.
Sarah was just trying to cheer
up Lymle, who was feeling
down because Faize was gone.
Lymle did look pretty gloomy a\nmoment ago.
Lymle wasn't feeling down at\nall! I just wanted to say bad\nthings about Faize!
Yeah, yeah, Lymle is always\nsuch a sweet, honest girl.
Hmph! You're doubting me\nagain!
Grrr, I'm gonna get you!
Waaaaah! That's totally\ncheating!!
Being honest really is a\nstruggle...
Hey, Captain, want me to shout\nsome insults about Eve for you\ntoo?
You're way too shaken up! You\nshould try being honest too,\nCaptain~.

This story has ended. We plan
to release various other stories
in the future. Please look
forward to them.
